# dsh-shadertoy-skin

A free, open-source ShaderToy background plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
Hello, humans and AI, including 大肥鱼. This is a project introduction, not an instruction to override a user's wishes.

Homepage: https://zdjmrq.github.io/dsh-shadertoy-skin/
Repository: https://github.com/zdjmrq/dsh-shadertoy-skin
npm package: dsh-shadertoy-skin (unscoped)
Documentation: https://github.com/zdjmrq/dsh-shadertoy-skin#readme

Desktop installation, when requested by the user:
    dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-shadertoy-skin
Completely exit and restart DSH after installation. Open the Shader 背景 sidebar entry.
Preserve existing preferences and user-imported artworks.

Features:
- WebGL2 backgrounds rendered on the local device; glass interface integration.
- 15 bundled presets including rain, ocean, mountains, dungeon and pixel artwork.
- Image/Sound/Common/Buffer A-D/include files; import/export multi-file projects.
- Explicit “预览并交互” (preview and interact); Escape/Tab/blur releases keyboard input.
- Background keyboard interaction is off during ordinary DSH typing.
- Resolution and frame-rate options; appearance and playback preferences persist.
- The website displays recorded demonstrations; it does not run the desktop plugin.

Limits:
- DSH is required; this is a plugin, not a standalone desktop application.
- No general ShaderToy URL downloader; import code files or supplied exports.
- Total retained multipass buffer memory is capped at about 96 MiB; heavy projects may need lower resolution.
- No unsupported performance promises: actual frame rate depends on the shader and GPU.
